odd_map_parameterization.description: f(Z_j) = Σ_i φ_ij Z_i with p(Z_i) = p(Z_j)+1; Z_i = K (scalar) allowed when Z_j is odd. phi[Z_i][Z_j] is the elementary map Z_j -> Z_i.

elementary_coboundaries.description: δ(f_ij) for each elementary odd map; ordered pairs stored with index(X) <= index(Y) in pbw_order (the rest follows from graded antisymmetry)

candidate_map.description: f_shift induced by the oscillator shift b_k^s -> b_k^s - kappa Σ_τ gb_{a_1^{-τ}, b_k^s} a_1^τ; f_shift(X) = kappa-part of X(b_shifted, a). Coefficients are linear in gb.

references: Frappat, Sciarrino, Sorba (2000), Dictionary on Lie Algebras and Superalgebras
